lead.topic: Thani Oruvan (2015): a hero who chooses his own villain
lead.insight: Mithran does not wait for a villain. He follows small crimes to the big men behind them and picks the one at the top: Siddharth Abhimanyu. The film then gives the villain his own story, so the cop and the scientist feel like two equal minds on opposite sides. A bigger villain makes a bigger hero.
lead.why_now: Thrillers keep working on the page (Ratsasan, Vikram). Thani Oruvan is a hit most people have seen but few have looked at as a hero-villain mirror. Works in any evening slot: TONIGHT.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thani_Oruvan (dir. Mohan Raja; Jayam Ravi as IPS officer Mithran, Arvind Swami as scientist Siddharth Abhimanyu; Mithran traces small crimes to the powerful men behind them and targets Siddharth)
lead.technique: Foil (a character who contrasts with and mirrors the hero)

lead.spoiler_note: Only the set-up (Mithran picks Siddharth) and that the villain gets his own story; nothing about the middle twist or the ending.

worth_it.learn: Thani Oruvan uses a foil: the villain mirrors the hero, so beating him means something.
worth_it.stop: A hero who picks his own villain.
worth_it.why_now: Thrillers are rising on the page; this is the hero-villain film everyone remembers.

worth_it.best_angle: Yes: the mirror is why the villain is as loved as the hero.

screens.voice: தனி ஒருவன். இந்த ஹீரோ, தன் வில்லனை தானே தேர்ந்தெடுக்கிறார். ஏன்?
screens.voice_tg: Thani Oruvan. Indha hero, than villanai thaane thernthedukkiraar. Yen?

screens.heading: HIS NIGHT HUNT
screens.voice: ராத்திரி ஆனா, மித்ரன் சின்ன குற்றங்களை துரத்துறார். அந்த குற்றங்கள், பெரிய ஆளுங்க கிட்ட போகுது. அந்த ஆளுங்க, ஒரே ஒரு பேருக்கு போறாங்க.
screens.voice_tg: Raaththiri aanaa, Mithran chinna kuttrangalai thuraththuraar. Andha kuttrangal, periya aalunga kitta pogudhu. Andha aalunga, ore oru perukku poraanga.

screens.name: THE FOIL
screens.definition: A RIVAL WHO MIRRORS THE HERO
screens.voice: இந்த டெக்னிக் பேரு, ஃபாயில். ஹீரோவை கண்ணாடி மாதிரி காட்டுற ஒரு எதிரி.
screens.voice_tg: Indha technique peru, foil. Herovai kannaadi maadhiri kaattura oru edhiri.

screens.voice: மித்ரன் ஒரு போலீஸ். சித்தார்த் ஒரு விஞ்ஞானி. ரெண்டு பேருமே ஜீனியஸ். வழி மட்டும் தான் வேற.
screens.voice_tg: Mithran oru police. Siddharth oru vinjnaani. Rendu perume genius. Vazhi mattum thaan vera.

screens.voice: வில்லன் பெருசா இருந்தா தான், ஹீரோ பெருசா தெரிவார். அதனால தான் படம், வில்லனுக்கும் ஒரு கதை கொடுக்குது.
screens.voice_tg: Villan perusaa irundhaa thaan, hero perusaa therivaar. Adhanaala thaan padam, villanukkum oru kadhai kodukkudhu.

screens.voice: உன் எதிரியை சொல்லு, நீ யாருன்னு சொல்றேன். இந்த படத்தோட மொத்த ஐடியா இது தான்.
screens.voice_tg: Un edhiriyai sollu, nee yaarunnu solren. Indha padaththoda moththa idea idhu thaan.

screens.voice: இது தான் ஃபாயில். உங்க ஃபேவரிட் தமிழ் வில்லன் யாரு? கமெண்ட்ல சொல்லுங்க.
screens.voice_tg: Idhu thaan foil. Unga favourite Tamil villain yaaru? Comment-la sollunga.

caption: In Thani Oruvan, the hero picks his own villain.

The technique is called a foil: a rival who mirrors the hero. Mithran the cop and Siddharth the scientist are equally sharp, on opposite sides, and the film gives the villain his own story too. A bigger villain makes a bigger hero. No spoilers here.
